stories.title: History comes home as St Louis City top Columbus Crew to win US Open Cup
summary: Title is club’s first-ever since 2023 foundingSt Louis clubs have won 11 Open Cups all-timeDaniel Edelman nets winner in 5-4 win on penaltiesFor much of the 20th century, winning the US Open Cup required a team to beat someone from St Louis.

MLS has won every Open Cup but one since starting play in 1996, and St Louis didn’t have an MLS club until 2023.From the beginning, club figures spoke of aims to restore the city to soccer prominence.

St Louis City are US Open Cup champions, outlasting the Columbus Crew 5-4 on penalties away from home to end the city’s 38-year wait for a major US soccer title and earn a place in the field for the 2027 Concacaf Champions Cup.
